description_en: Modifies the log storage region in Log Management
description_zh: 修改日志管理中的日志存储地域
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-data-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --data-storage-region-id cn-shanghai --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataStorage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns a 400 error: "The specified Lang can not be empty." Set this parameter to zh or en
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：此参数实际为必填项，未传入时API返回400错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」，请指定zh或en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The region where logs are stored
parameters.name: data_storage_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The global log delivery switch in Log Management. This setting is not yet available. Valid values:
enable: Enables all log delivery.
disable: Disables all log delivery
parameters.help_zh:
日志管理全局投递开关，暂未放开设置。取值：
enable：开通全部投递。
disable：关闭全部投递
parameters.name: delivery_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for
